messages.subject: New MaAsLin Forum !
parts:
Hello MaAsLin users! 

Please direct all future questions about MaAsLin to our new Discourse forum:
https://forum.biobakery.org/
This forum can be viewed by anyone, but you will need to ***create an account to post a new question***. 
This Google Group is now set as "read only": You may continue to browse existing message threads within the Group, but new messages sent to the Group will bounce back as "undeliverable".

By migrating all questions and answers to a centralized forum, we aim to both increase their visibility across the bioBakery user community in addition to improving response times.
Sincerely,
The bioBakery Support Team
